name: University of Coimbra – Alta and Sofia
description: Perched on a hill above the Mondego River in central Portugal, the University of Coimbra is one of the world's oldest universities still in operation, chartered in 1290. It has occupied the former royal palace since 1537. Visitors can wander between 16th-century colleges, a baroque library, and an 18th-century botanical garden, all within the old town.
